name: IPGeolocation_Security
author: IPGeolocation.io
description: Check an IP address with IPGeolocation.io: threat score and VPN, proxy, Tor, relay, bot, spam and known attacker signals. Paid plans.

configurationItems.name: api_key
configurationItems.description: IPGeolocation.io API key. Free plans cover IP location and user agent parsing; domain location, security, ASN and abuse contact lookups need a paid plan.

configurationItems.name: base_url
configurationItems.description: Base URL of the IPGeolocation.io API

configurationItems.name: suspicious_threshold
configurationItems.description: Threat score (0-100) from which the result is tagged suspicious. Lower scores are tagged info.

configurationItems.name: malicious_threshold
configurationItems.description: Threat score (0-100) from which the result is tagged malicious. Set it above 100 to never tag malicious.
